summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of core functionality. Strengths: excellent unit test organization (glob matching, rules parsing, label computation separated logically), strong end-to-end integration testing via act (4 fixture cases, exact output assertions), good error handling coverage (missing files, malformed rules, bad CLI arguments all tested), proper setup/teardown isolation, and clear test naming. Weaknesses: some edge cases unexercised (category '-' non-conflicting rules, JSON escape with special chars like newlines, negative priorities, same-priority rule ties, unicode in labels), no direct shellcheck/bash-n validation tests (though referenced in requirements), parse_workflow.py helper and fixture file contents not shown (must assume correctness), missing visibility into the workflow file being tested. Would effectively catch regressions in main label-assignment logic and prevent CI/CD integration failures, but some edge cases could slip through.
